newsitem.title: UK: UK natural gas firms slightly, but OTC quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK natural gas firms slightly, but OTC quiet.

text.p: The UK natural gas spot market was slightly firmer but fairly quiet on Monday with traders choosing to do most of their business on the futures market.
Prices were slightly stronger across the forward curve, with a couple of prompt deals done at 9.7 pence a therm (p/th) for day ahead gas and 9.775 p/th for within day.
The fourth quarter was heard traded at 13.40 p/th and more deals were heard to have been done on a confidential basis.
"It's basically slightly stronger, although it's nothing really dramatic," said one trader.
First quarter 1998 was traded at 17.10 p/th and 17.20 p/th, and was heavily traded on the futures market with a major shipper dominating proceedings.
Next summer was untraded on the over-the-counter market, but made healthy gains on the futures market, although traders said there was no fundamental sentiment behind it.
"It was all profit-related. We bought it when it was low and threw it out when people thought there was a buyer," said one active player.
